'''Swamp lentil soup''' was a type of [[Soup/Legends|soup]]. It was one of the dishes served at the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] event on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR Onslaught" />
